news.title: Which player has the most career points in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Какой игрок набрал наибольшее количество карьерных очков в истории НХЛ?
news.description: Wayne Gretzky leads the list of NHL players with the most career points. Check out other top performers now.

news.title: Who has scored the most goals in NHL history?
news.ruTitle: Кто забил больше всего голов в истории НХЛ?
news.description: Alex Ovechkin holds the record for the most individual career goals in NHL history. Which other players are at the top of the list?

news.title: Nikita Kucherov passes Steven Stamkos to become Lightning's career points leader
news.ruTitle: Никита Кучеров обогнал Стивена Стэмкоса и стал лидером по очкам в карьере «Лайтнинг»
news.description: Nikita Kucherov became the Tampa Bay Lightning's career points leader with an assist in the first period against the Utah Mammoth.

news.title: Nylander scores twice to reach 300 NHL goals as Maple Leafs rout Oilers 7-2
news.ruTitle: Нюландер забил дважды и забил 300 голов в НХЛ, когда "Мэйпл Лифс" разгромили "Ойлерз" со счетом 7-2
news.description: — William Nylander scored twice to reach 300 NHL goals, Anthony Stolarz made 30 saves and the Toronto Maple Leafs routed the Edmonton Oilers 7-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Drake Batherson has 3 goals and an assist in the Senators' 7-4 victory over the Rangers
news.ruTitle: На счету Дрейка Батерсона 3 гола и результативная передача в победе "Сенаторс" над "Рейнджерс" со счетом 7:4.
news.description: — Drake Batherson had three goals and an assist and the Ottawa Senators outscored the New York Rangers 7-4 on Saturday night.

news.title: Ville Koivunen scores in OT as Penguins rally for 3-2 win over Predators
news.ruTitle: Вилле Койвунен забивает в овертайме, когда «Пингвинз» сплотились и одержали победу над «Предаторз» со счетом 3:2
news.description: — Ville Koivunen scored at 3:44 of overtime and the Pittsburgh Penguins rallied to beat the Nashville Predators 3-2 on Saturday night.

news.title: Bruins extend points streak to 8 games with 6-4 win over Sharks
news.ruTitle: Брюинз продлили очковую серию до 8 игр, одержав победу над Шаркс со счетом 6-4.
news.description: — James Hagens and David Pastrnak scored in a 40-second span in the third period, and the Boston Bruins extended their points streak to eight games with a 6-4 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday night.

news.title: Fantilli scores on OT power play as Blue Jackets edge Golden Knights 2-1
news.ruTitle: Фантилли забивает гол в большинстве овертаймов, а «Блю Джекетс» побеждают «Голден Найтс» со счетом 2:1
news.description: — Adam Fantilli scored on a power play 59 seconds into overtime and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat Vegas 2-1 on Saturday night, sending the Golden Knights to their third straight loss.

news.title: Alex Tuch gets winner against former team and Dylan Strome scores twice, as Capitals beat Sabres 4-3
news.ruTitle: Алекс Тач одержал победу над бывшей командой, а Дилан Стром забил дважды, когда «Кэпиталз» обыграли «Сэйбрз» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Alex Tuch scored two goals, including the winner in overtime, to lead the Washington Capitals to a win over the Buffalo Sabres, 4-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Kochetkov makes 24 saves to help the Hurricanes beat the Blues 4-0
news.ruTitle: Кочетков сделал 24 сейва и помог "Харрикейнз" обыграть "Блюз" со счетом 4-0.
news.description: — Pyotr Kochetkov made 24 saves for his first shutout of the season and 12th in the NHL in the Carolina Hurricanes' 4-0 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.

news.title: Brett Pesce scores go-ahead goal as Devils beat Kings 3-1 for 3rd straight win
news.ruTitle: Бретт Пеше забивает гол, когда «Девилз» обыграли «Кингз» со счетом 3:1 и одержали третью победу подряд
news.description: — Brett Pesce scored the go-ahead goal and Jake Allen made 12 saves as the New Jersey Devils beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-1 on Saturday for their third straight win.

news.title: Leo Carlsson, offered by Flyers, burns Philly in Ducks' win
news.ruTitle: Лео Карлссон, предложенный Флайерз, сжигает Филадельфию в победе Дакс
news.description: Leo Carlsson showed what the Flyers missed out on after scoring and assisting on the game-winner in the Ducks' 5-4 win.
